title: 湯気の向こうの記憶書庫
author: 久我山 灯子

en.title: Memories Beyond the Steam
en.premise: Ten years after estranging herself from her father, a woman returns to her hometown and discovers a 'library of family history' hidden in her home's basement. Through the records her awkward father had been secretly compiling and the moments spent recreating her mother's recipes, the frozen time between parent and child begins to move once more.

zh.title: 蒸汽彼端的记忆书库
zh.premise: 讲述了一位与父亲断绝关系十年后重返故乡的女性，意外发现了隐藏在自家地下室里的“记录家族历史的图书馆”。通过翻阅笨拙的父亲秘密写下的记录，以及重现母亲食谱的烹饪时光，那段停滞不前的亲子时光终于再次开始流动。
